title: Canadian CP Registry - Registre Canadien de la Paralysie Cérébrale
brief_summary: The Canadian Cerebral Palsy (CP) Registry is a confidential, nation-wide collection of medical and social information about children with cerebral palsy. The Registry was first implemented in 2003 in 6 administrative regions of Quebec and was later extended to paediatric centres in Newfoundland, Nova Scotia, Ontario, Alberta, and British Columbia. Over 1850 children living with Cerebral Palsy have been registered so far. The Registry is the first national registry for cerebral palsy in North America.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Under 18 (age cut-off varies by region)
* Diagnosed with Cerebral Palsy
* Living in Canada

Exclusion Criteria:

* Uncertain CP diagnosis
study_population: Children living with a diagnosis of Cerebral Palsy in Canada.
